description: Built-in workflow for Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes, Azure, Jenkins, TypeORM, Postgres and Jira: tasks, status bar items, commands and migration checks.
config.title: Docker Compose
config.compose.autoDetect: Controls whether services in Docker Compose files are detected as tasks. Detection runs `docker compose config` for each Compose file in the workspace.
compose.taskDefinition.file.description: The Compose file, relative to the workspace folder.
compose.taskDefinition.service.descripti: The service to run the command for. Omit to run it for every service in the file.
compose.taskDefinition.args.description: Extra arguments to pass to the command, before the service name.
problemMatcher.nestWatch.label: NestJS dev server (ready when the application has started)
problemMatcher.angularServe.label: Angular dev server (ready when the bundle has been generated)
config.devTools.helm.autoDetect: Controls whether Helm charts in the workspace are detected as lint, template and dependency tasks.
config.helm.title: Helm
config.devTools.typeorm.autoDetect: Controls whether TypeORM data sources and migration scripts are detected as migration tasks.
config.devTools.typeorm.dataSourceFiles: Glob pattern of the files searched for a `new DataSource(...)`. Each one becomes a migration project; its Nx targets or package scripts named like `migration:run` are used when present, and the TypeORM CLI otherwise.
config.devTools.typeorm.migrationWarning: Controls whether SQL in a migration's `up` method that can lose data or lock tables (DROP, TRUNCATE, type changes, renames, non-concurrent indexes) is flagged.
config.typeorm.title: TypeORM
config.devTools.postgres.syncSqlToolsCon: Controls whether a SQLTools connection is kept in the user settings for each Postgres service in the workspace's Compose files.
config.postgres.title: Postgres
config.devTools.jenkins.url: Address of the Jenkins server. Set with the Jenkins: Sign In command, which keeps the API token in secret storage.
config.devTools.jenkins.cliJar: Path of jenkins-cli.jar. When empty, the jar is downloaded from the Jenkins server.
config.devTools.jenkins.javaPath: Path of the java executable that runs jenkins-cli.jar. When empty, JAVA_HOME and then the PATH are used.
config.jenkins.title: Jenkins
config.devTools.kubernetes.statusBar: Controls whether the current kube context and namespace are shown in the status bar.
config.devTools.kubernetes.productionCon: Regular expression, matched without case, for context names that are production. Production contexts are highlighted, and opening a shell in them asks first.
config.kubernetes.title: Kubernetes
config.devTools.azure.statusBar: Controls whether the active Azure CLI subscription is shown in the status bar.
config.azure.title: Azure
config.devTools.jira.hover: Controls whether hovering a work item key such as PROJ-123 shows the work item, loaded with the twg CLI.
config.devTools.jira.projectKeys: Jira project keys to recognize, such as APS. When empty, any key-like text is looked up.
config.devTools.jira.branchPrefix: Prefix of branches made by Start Work on Ticket. Bugs use bugfix/.
config.jira.title: Jira
command.postgres.syncConnections: Sync SQLTools Connections from Compose Files
helm.taskDefinition.chart.description: The chart folder, relative to the workspace folder.
helm.taskDefinition.command.description: The Helm command to run for the chart.
typeorm.taskDefinition.project.descripti: The project folder that holds the data source, relative to the workspace folder.
typeorm.taskDefinition.name.description: Name of the migration to generate.
jenkins.taskDefinition.job.description: Full name of the Jenkins job to build.
config.git.title: Git
config.devTools.git.changesStatusBar: Controls whether the number of changed files in the active repository is shown in the status bar. Clicking it opens the diff.
